proposals.lesson: For a hybrid decoder such as Qwen3.5, do not transplant a pruned-layer list from a homogeneous Llama-family model. Measure Block Influence on the real workload, report rankings by layer type, and freeze the candidate set before E2E testing.
proposals.evidence: The physical-NPU4-7 run collected 2,048 observations across all 64 layers and achieved minimum four-split Spearman 0.9989926739926738, producing the frozen Qwen3.5-specific remove8 set 3,4,5,7,8,9,12,13.

proposals.lesson: Land observability and the opt-in execution hook default off before spending NPU time. This preserves the serving path, gives a reversible integration seam, and separates measurement overhead from the pruning treatment.
proposals.evidence: Local vLLM-Ascend commit 54a6bb40ac83771538b3c859bcf9c55e2e51854a passes py_compile/diff checks and 9/9 focused tests in the exact 0.23.0 image with backend autoload disabled. A direct-module smoke validates head/tail selection, identity influence, JSONL output, and distributed-rank precedence without allocating an NPU.

proposals.lesson: A prefill-only ShortGPT shortcut cannot improve decode TPOT. For this goal, the selected layer set must be skipped in both prefill and decode while preserving the decoder's deferred residual representation.
proposals.evidence: The remove8 implementation skipped the same layers in prefill and decode and improved retained TPOT in all cells by 1.0530x to 1.1365x, although the candidate was held by the independent semantic gate.

proposals.lesson: Place Docker inspect formatting flags before the container id in resource guards. On this host, putting --format after the id is parsed as another object and can turn a safe reservation check into an early generic failure.
proposals.evidence: The first live conflict probe exited 1 with four 'No such object' errors; the corrected order detected /p0_mc and exited 48 without creating a directory or container.

proposals.lesson: A highly stable Block Influence ranking is a candidate-selection signal, not a correctness proof. Require a same-runtime unpruned control and stop the pruning ladder at the first semantic regression even when every latency cell improves.
proposals.evidence: Remove8 used a ranking with minimum Spearman 0.9989926739926738 and improved retained TPOT in all four cells, yet c1/c8/c16 each lost 0.03125 mean normalized character similarity versus control. The 0.02 gate correctly held the candidate and prevented remove16/remove20.
